dcat_keyword_sm: biotelemetry; hydropower; fish; rainbow trout; mountain whitefish
dct_description_sm: Download the complete TDG folder and retain the file structure. Run the R project file (TDG.Rproj) in the TDG > TDG folder and all of the scripts and necessary data files are provided and preloaded. The user will need to install the necessary packages into R or R Studio.

This data deposit is for a project that examined fish movements downstream of two hydropower facilities in relation to modeled total dissolved gas levels. A risk analysis was conducted to determine fish exposure risk. The dataset is an R project containing the R scripts/code and data (biotelemetry, hydropower operations, mapping shapefiles, and total dissolved gas) necessary to replicate the data and statistical analyses for the biotelemetry/total dissolved gas exposure risk analysis.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: TDG biotelemetry project
